purpose: Front, right-side, and rear layered player previews used to approve true body turning and weapon occlusion before any multi-direction production expansion.
camera: one orthographic camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees; camera and character elevation remain locked for front, right-side, and rear yaw
facing: three discrete true-yaw previews: front/toward camera, right-side/profile, and rear/away from camera
lighting: stable cyan rim light, restrained magenta equipment accents, warm orange weapon emission
prompt: Using the approved Player B body reference, create one isolated full-body gameplay character at the requested yaw under the exact same orthographic camera pitched downward 45 degrees. Preserve the same compact armored identity, helmet, cyan visor, backpack, body proportions, worn composite materials, palette, lighting, scale, and neutral two-hand rifle-ready stance. Remove the rifle only and reconstruct any hidden armor and forearms while keeping both hands around a credible invisible grip. Use a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background.
negative_constraints: no horizontal eye-level camera or camera roll
no whole-sprite rotation, mirrored anatomy, identity drift, outfit change, or proportion change
no rifle, effect, muzzle flash, shell, text, watermark, border, divider, ground, or shadow
no translucent armor interior or green within the subject
do not crop helmet, backpack, hands, legs, or boots

references.role: approved Player B identity and true front, side, rear body construction
approved body-only rendering, 45-degree camera, and two-hand invisible grip
YouMind 27303 tactical armor and weapon-hand relationship

generation_model: imagegen built-in plus local chroma-key removal and deterministic Pillow/Godot preview composition
